passage: After a six-week pilot, the four-day support schedule reduced average ticket resolution time by 18 percent and did not lower customer satisfaction. However, Friday coverage became thin after 3 p.m., causing a small backlog each weekend. Leadership will extend the pilot for another month, add a rotating Friday shift, and decide whether to adopt the schedule permanently after reviewing the new data.

keyPoints.text: The four-day support pilot improved resolution time without reducing satisfaction.
Thin Friday coverage created weekend backlogs.
The pilot will be extended with a rotating Friday shift before a permanent decision.

referenceAnswer: The four-day support pilot improved resolution time without hurting satisfaction, but Friday coverage needs fixing before a permanent decision.
